spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (नमति)
To bow, to pay obeisance.
r. 10th cl. (नमयति-नामयति)
To bend, to bow: see णम.

ind.
A particle implying,
1

Certainty.
2

Possibility.
3

Anger.
4

Reproach.
5

Consent, promise.
6

Recollection.
7

Surprise.
8

Pretence, &c. as हिमालयो नाम नगाधिपः Himālaya, evidently the king of mountains, इह नाम सीता भविष्यति SĪTĀ will perhaps be here, &c.
E.
णम to call or address, affix ड, deriv. irr.

mfn. (-मन्-मन्ती-मत्)
Bending, stooping, bowed.
E.
नम to bow, शतृ aff.

m. (-तः)
1 A master, a lord.
2 An actor, a mime.
3 A cloud.
E.
नम to bow or bend, Uṇādi affix अतच्.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Bending, directing downward, declining.
E.
नम to bow. r. 10th cl. शतृ aff.

ind.
1 Gift, present.
2 Bowing, bending, salutation, obeisance.
3 An inarticulate cry.
4 The term used in connexion with the name of a deity in the fifth case to signify veneration, as रामाय नमः salutation, glory or reverence to RĀMA.
E.
नम to bend, and affix असुन्.

m. (-सः)
Agreement, concord.
E.
नम to bow, affix कसच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Reverenced, respected, worshipped.
E.
नमस् bowing, क्यप् affix, and क्त added, य rejected: see नमस्यित.

m. (-रः)
1 Respectful or reverential address or salutation.
2 A sort of poison.
f. (-री)
A sensitive plant.
E.
नमस् bowing, and कार making, fem. affix ङीप्.

ind.
Having saluted reverentially.
E.
नमस्, and कृत्वा having made.

mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
Venerable, respectable, entitled to salutation or civility.
f. (-स्या)
Reverence, respect, worship, adoration.
E.
नमस् respect, क्यप् aff.

mfn. (-स्यन्-स्यन्ती-स्यत्)
Saluting reverentially, bowing to, paying adoration.
E.
नमस् nominal verb, to bow, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Reverenced, respected, worshipped.
E.
नमस् respect, affix क्यप्, and the participial affix क्त; also नमसित.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Bowed, making salutation or obeisance.
2 Bowed, bent down.
E.
नम to bend, causal form, affix क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Bent, bent down, bowed.
E.
णम to bow, causal form, क्त aff.

m. (-चिः)
1 The deity of love.
2 A demon so named.
E.
न negative, मुच to loose, and कि aff.

m. (-नः)
A name of INDRA.
E.
नमुचि the demon, and सूदन destroyer; also similar names, as नमुचिद्विष्, &c.

m. (-रुः)
The seed of the Elæocarpus.
E.
न not, मेरु the mountain Meru.

m. (-रुः)
A spiritual teacher.
E.
नमस् reverence, and गुरु a teacher.

r. 1st cl. (नम्बति)
To go, to move.

mfn. (-म्रः-म्रा-म्रं)
Crooked, curved, bent, bowed.
E.
नम to bow, affix र.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Bent or bowed, stooping.
E.
कन् added to the last.

mfn. (-खः-खी-खं)
Looking down, having the head bent.
E.
नम्र, and मुख the face.

mfn. (-र्त्तिः-र्त्तिः-र्त्ति)
Bending down, stooping, bowed.
E.
नम्र, and मूर्त्ति form.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
Bent, bowed, stooping.
E.
नम्र, and अङ्ग the body.

n. (-णं)
Naming a child first after birth.
E.
नाम, and करण making.

n. (-हं)
Addressing by name.
E.
नाम, and ग्रह taking; also नामग्रहण.

f. (-शी)
A religious ceremony, worshipping DURGĀ daily under one of twelve appellations.
E.
नाम, and द्वादशी twelfth.

n. (-यं)
A name or appellation.
E.
नाम a name, and धेय aff.

n. (-म)
A name, an appellation.
E.
म्ना to be minded or remembered, मनिन् Uṇādi affix, deriv. irr.

m. (-षः-षा-षं)
Dead, deceased.
m. (-षः)
Dying, death.
E.
नाम a name, and शेष end.

m. (-धः)
Abusing a respectable object, as a pious man, a deity by name.
E.
नाम, and अपराध offence.
